method: Compared every answer to its synthetic reference. Exact matches retained as correct. Distinct fictional person/place names and years were checked against the canonical reference and retained as incorrect when they differed. For occupation prompts, accepted the explicitly listed trade/activity forms when they identify the same occupation. The single truncated output remains invalid. No outside-world fact checking was used because the entities and facts are fictional.
